name: Hunting Horn
author: RaintDM
entries: I'm not hiding (RaintDM), this change is also purely intentional so that the Bard can use this weapon. It seems to me that, conceptually, a weapon that buffs your allies in combat using music is entirely Bardic, but Amellwind's homebrew takes the weapon purely as MH presents it, which is fine. However, I'm taking the creative liberty of making some changes so that it's possible for a Bard to use it.

rows: Instrument of War (The Bard Fix), Recital, Solo Recital, Songbook
Melody of Might, Melody of Swiftness, Melody of Precision, Melody of Guile
Melody of Warding, Melody of Focus, Melody of Harmful Acid, Melody of Harmful Cold, Melody of Harmful Fire, Melody of Harmful Lightning, Melody of Harmful Thunder
Magnificent Trio, Solo Recital Upgrade, Expanded Songbook II, Earthshaker

Melody of Clarity, Melody of Vigor, Melody of Fortitude, Melody of Recovery, Melody of the Wilds, Melody of Resistant Acid, Melody of Resistant Cold, Melody of Resistant Fire, Melody of Resistant Lightning, Melody of Resistant Thunder

customFeatures.name: Mastery (Topple)
customFeatures.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

customFeatures.name: Instrument of War (The Bard Fix)
customFeatures.description: This weapon doubles as a musical instrument and a spellcasting focus. If you have the Bardic Inspiration feature, you gain proficiency with this weapon, it loses the Heavy property for you (allowing Small races to wield it comfortably), and you can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength for its attack and damage rolls.

customFeatures.name: Recital
customFeatures.description: The horn relies on the momentum of combat to generate its magic. When you hit a creature with this weapon on your turn, you can use your Bonus Action to perform a Recital. This ends all Melodies currently active from your Songbook, then activates one Melody of your choice. That Melody emits a 15-foot aura centered on you that lasts for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you activate Melodies again.

customFeatures.name: Solo Recital
customFeatures.description: As a Bonus Action, you can perform a Solo Recital without hitting a creature. This ends all Melodies currently active from your Songbook, then activates one Melody of your choice. That Melody emits a 15-foot aura centered on you that lasts for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you activate Melodies again.

customFeatures.name: Songbook
customFeatures.description: You know two Melodies of your choice. You can change your known Melodies whenever you finish a Long Rest.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Might
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura (including you) can add 1d4 to the damage rolls.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Swiftness
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura have their Speed increased by 10 feet and ignore Difficult Terrain.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Precision
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Guile
customFeatures.description: When you activate this Melody, choose one skill. Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to checks using that skill.

customFeatures.name: Encore
customFeatures.description: Your mastery over the horn's acoustics improves. When you perform a Recital, after ending all currently active Melodies you can activate two different Melodies at the same time instead of one.

customFeatures.name: Expanded Songbook
customFeatures.description: You know three Melodies.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Warding
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Class.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Focus
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura (including you) gain a +1 bonus to their spell save DCs.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Harmful Acid
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura deal an extra 1d4 Acid damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Harmful Cold
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura deal an extra 1d4 Cold damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Harmful Fire
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura deal an extra 1d4 Fire damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Harmful Lightning
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura deal an extra 1d4 Lightning damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Harmful Thunder
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura deal an extra 1d4 Thunder damage.

customFeatures.name: Magnificent Trio
customFeatures.description: When you perform a Recital, after ending all currently active Melodies you can activate up to three different Melodies at the same time.

customFeatures.name: Solo Recital Upgrade
customFeatures.description: When you perform a Solo Recital, you can activate two different Melodies instead of one after ending all currently active Melodies.

customFeatures.name: Expanded Songbook II
customFeatures.description: You know four Melodies.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Clarity
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura have Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Vigor
customFeatures.description: At the start of each of their turns, allies in the aura gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma or Strength modifier (minimum of 1).

customFeatures.name: Melody of Fortitude
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Recovery
customFeatures.description: At the start of each of their turns, allies in the aura regain Hit Points equal to your Charisma or Strength modifier (minimum of 1).

customFeatures.name: Melody of the Wilds
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura can move across calm liquid as if it were solid ground, and they suffer no harm from extreme cold or extreme heat.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Resistant Acid
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain Resistance to Acid damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Resistant Cold
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain Resistance to Cold damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Resistant Fire
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain Resistance to Fire damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Resistant Lightning
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain Resistance to Lightning damage.

customFeatures.name: Melody of Resistant Thunder
customFeatures.description: Allies in the aura gain Resistance to Thunder damage.

customFeatures.name: Earthshaker
customFeatures.description:
As an Action, you slam the horn into the ground to release a devastating shockwave. Every hostile creature within a 20-foot radius must make a Constitution saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Charisma modifier. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Thunder damage and is Deafened for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Alternatively, if you have the Spellcasting or Bardic Inspiration features, you can bypass this restriction by expending a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, or 2 uses of your Bardic Inspiration.

customFeatures.name: Infernal Melody
customFeatures.description: Once per Long Rest, when you hit a creature, you can use your Bonus Action to play the ultimate song. For the next minute, your aura radius expands to 30 feet, and whenever an ally in the aura scores a hit with an attack, they deal maximum damage with their weapon's base damage dice (for example, a 1d8 longsword automatically rolls an 8).

customFeatures.name: Songbook Mastery
customFeatures.description: You know all available Melodies and can switch which ones are active whenever you perform a Recital or Solo Recital.
